From platforming around to activating switches, the pitchfork becomes a handy and versatile tool that you'll want for all your underground escapades.

Pitchfork is a short-but-sweet difficult platformer for both PC and Gameboy/Gameboy Color!

name: Reunited in the Mist
overview:
You're out for a walk when you bump into a woman you haven't seen in years.

You were in love with her, once upon a time. After so long, how will you make things right?

name: Yurivania 3: Circle of the Polycule
overview:
Never's polycule has been chatting via magic mirror for months, but most of them haven't met in person. An upcoming eclipse is the perfect opportunity to summon them all to the Midnight Palace and go on a group date!

Now it's a matter of balancing all their schedules, carefully researching the right mystic glyphs, and invoking dread powers to bring everyone together!

Async flirting and remote emotional support are one thing, but will a mushroomgirl, slimemould, machinegirl, scarecrow, mystery witch, and void-horror all get along face-to-face?? They will if Never has anything to say about it!

name: Crypto-Fascist
overview: You play as a government agent pushing pills and stack bitcoin in a classic "block pushing puzzle" game.

name: After Burner
overview: Game Boy Advance port of arcade game After Burner, included in Sega Arcade Gallery.

name: Space Harrier
overview: Game Boy Advance port of arcade game Space Harrier, included in Sega Arcade Gallery.

name: Super Hang-On
overview: Game Boy Advance port of arcade game Super Hang-On, included in Sega Arcade Gallery.

name: Portal Advance
overview: Portal clone for Game Boy Advance.

name: Mantle
overview:
A half-demake, half-fangame reconstruction of a certain part of Deltarune Chapter 3 for the actual NES!

Made over the course of 3 months, this is an NES remake of certain events in Chapter 3 - but with a few twists of its own...

name: Zen: Intergalactic Ninja
overview: A Game Boy action platformer based on the eco-themed comic book character. Players control Zen through twelve levels spanning environmental disaster zones, fighting pollution-themed bosses and completing recycling bonus rounds in an isometric perspective with multidirectional scrolling.

name: Best of the Best: Championship Karate
Best of the Best: Championship Karate
Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves
overview: A Game Boy adaptation of the 1991 film, featuring multiple gameplay modes including overhead exploration, one-on-one side-view duels, large-scale melee battles, and horse racing sequences. Players guide Robin Hood through missions as he builds his band of outlaws and fights to free England from the Sheriff of Nottingham.

name: Roger Clemens' MVP Baseball
overview: Port to SNES and Mega Drive/Genesis.

name: Frank Thomas Big Hurt Baseball
overview:
Frank Thomas Big Hurt Baseball for Game Boy adapts the console versions' gameplay and options to the capabilities of the handheld systems.

While based on the 1995 MLB season, the game does not have a MLB license, so there are no real team names used. It does however have a MLBPA license, so features real player names and their associated statistics.

name: Darkman
overview: A side-scrolling platformer based on the 1990 Sam Raimi film. Players control Darkman through action levels, using disguises that dissolve in sunlight to impersonate gangsters and gain their abilities. Between levels, a photography minigame determines how much time is granted for the next stage.

name: Star Trek: Generations - Beyond the Nexus
Spider-Man and the X-Men in Arcade's Revenge
overview:
The Game Boy version of Spider-Man and the X-Men in Arcade's Revenge is a side-scrolling action-platform game based on the console release. It follows Spider-Man, Cyclops, Storm, Gambit, and Wolverine as they attempt to escape Arcade's Murderworld, with each character using distinct abilities to navigate hazards and defeat enemies.

The handheld version retains the introductory Spider-Man stage followed by character-specific stages that can be completed in any order, but reduces the structure to one main stage for each hero before the final confrontation with Arcade. Several stages were shortened or altered for the Game Boy, including Spider-Man's section, which is based on his second console stage and features a battle with Carnage.

name: Five Nights at Freddy's: NES
overview: Five Nights at Freddy's: NES is a demake of FNAF 1 to the NES, with some slight tweaks made to gameplay in order to spice up the experience. You'll be utilizing your doors, lights, and monitor to ward off any roaming animatronics that try to reach you. Can you survive Five Nights at Freddy's: NES? Good luck.

name: Game of Life Kuzushi
overview: Game of Life Kuzushi is a homebrew game for Game Boy, that mixes Conway's Game of Life, with a block breaker game.

name: Test Drive: Off-Road 3
overview: The Game Boy Color port of "Test Drive: Off-Road 3". (released as "4X4 World Trophy" in Europe)

name: Tonka Raceway
overview: Tonka trucks come to the Game Boy Color for some racing in TONKA RACEWAY. You can choose from four different vehicles including a dump truck, 4X4, racecar, and bulldozer. After you have chosen the perfect vehicle, get on one of the three tracks: "Tropical Paradise," "Scorching Desert," or the "Winter Wonderland." Your biggest challenge will be to try and stay off of the walls and in the lead. Once you cross the finish line, you receive points that you can use to upgrade your vehicle in four different areas: tires, shocks, turbo, and engine. Thanks to the built-in rumble capabilities, you will feel every bump and jolt in the game. Try to become a driving champion with TONKA RACEWAY.

name: OutRun GB
overview: A fanmade homebrew Demake of the original OutRun for the Game Boy Color released on Itch.io. It features the same levels, themes, and branching paths and music as the original.

name: Tom and Jerry in House Trap
Bygone Snow
overview:
When the world ends, who will you spend your final hours with?

A short story (around an hour) about two people and their relationship as their time comes to an end.

name: Super Bug Hunters
overview: Blast tons of enemies you encounter along your way in this frenetic run 'n gun with multiplayer support!

name: Capybara Village
overview: A cozy little game with capybaras, set in a Japanese village.

name: Sofia the Witch: Curse of the Monster Moon
overview:
You play as Sofia, a plucky little witch that will do whatever she can to save her friends from their terrible curse.

Using your two spells, Transmogrification and Bubble Bounce, explore levels, discover secrets, and save your friends.

name: Dhilly Game 6 Remake
overview: A remake of the original "Dhilly Game 6" focused on giving the game more polish.

name: Duckstroma
overview: Meet Aura, she's a delivery duck and about to have a life changing day on the job. A client has requested 8 disks be delivered to them, but this won't be an easy task. Using Aura's skills navigate the hostile environment by bouncing on weak foes, even lay an egg to reach higher spots.

name: Exodus: Journey to the Promised Land
Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord
overview: NES / Famicom port of the first game in the Wizardry series.

name: Dorotea
overview:
Dorotea is a researcher specializing in the history of her hometown of Conversano, near Bari, in Italy

An important event is just days away. Her job involves cataloging and archiving books and artifacts dating back to the 17th century, stored in a room that hasn't been opened in decades.

But the past never stops watching her...

The game is a horror top-down adventure for the Game Boy and Game Boy Color

name: Dorotea
overview:
Dorotea is a researcher specializing in the history of her hometown of Conversano, near Bari, in Italy

An important event is just days away. Her job involves cataloging and archiving books and artifacts dating back to the 17th century, stored in a room that hasn't been opened in decades.

But the past never stops watching her...

The game is a horror top-down adventure for the Game Boy and Game Boy Color

name: Disney's 102 Dalmatians: Puppies to the Rescue
Alentejo: The Tinto & The Ugly
overview: Welcome back to the nostalgic Old Alentejo. In this historical 19th-century European western, help Gildo, Dolores, and Pepe in their quest to fight Baron Tinto and his oppressive laws. To do so, you’ll need to cross the historic border, explore new locations, discover more items, allies, and… new enemies! The Tinto has never meant so much to so many people in so many ways!

name: Ys III: Wanderers from Ys
publisher: Tokyo Shoseki Co., Ltd., Tonkin House
overview:
Adol Christin's long-time friend, Dogi, wishes to return to his home town of Redmont after hearing about strange disturbances that are happening there. Always looking for an adventure, Adol joins him and soon finds out the cause of this new evil.

s: Wanderers from Ys breaks away from the "bumping into enemies" battle system of the first two games, allowing Adol to control his sword in a variety of directions. Beside changing the battle system, the game's perspective switches to a side-scrolling view, as opposed to the top-down one of the previous games. Adol also has the ability to jump now. New to the series is the use of magical rings, which give Adol different powering-up abilities such as healing and shielding. The game also uses various key items found along the way to solve minor puzzles and progress the story.

name: Logical
overview: Adds a distinctive puzzle game experience to the Game Boy Color. Each of the 99 levels starts with a unique arrangement of pipes and slotted gears. Balls of various colors roll through a pipe at the top of the screen, and they'll fall into the gear and pipe arrangement. The goal is to get balls of the same color to fill all of the slots of a gear. Once that happens, the balls disappear. But time is always a factor in doing this, so you've got to be efficient. As the game progresses, several complicating factors enter the mix: some pipes will only allow balls to travel one way, and other will only let balls of one color pass through. The biggest problem is that some levels require colors be removed in a particular order. Try to solve as many puzzles as you can with LOGICAL.

name: Buck and the Cursed Cartridge
overview: When Buck, a die-hard retro gamer, buys a mysterious cartridge labeled “DEFINITELY NOT A CURSED CARTRIDGE” from his local GameStop, things go sideways fast. The moment he pops it into his Chromatic, he’s sucked through the screen and trapped inside the game! To escape, Buck must battle through pixelated worlds, outsmart glitchy bosses, and uncover who—or what—is pulling the strings. With help from a rogue hacker, hidden cheats, and his trusty blaster, Buck’s only way out is to beat the game itself.

name: Night at the Harbor
overview:
Night at the Harbor is a short, ultra-retro, psychological horror/horror game about a fisherman who lost his phone.

Synopsis:
After a long day of fishing, Hopper returns to the harbor to dock his boat and head on home. He gets back to his truck and realizes he left his phone on the boat, his decision to go back and get it might be the last choice he ever makes.

name: Lamborghini: American Challenge
overview: Lamborghini: American Challenge is a racing game where players start with a basic Lamborghini and $6000, competing across 60 tracks in the United States to advance through four racing divisions. Players race against championship rivals and local drivers while avoiding police who pursue speeders exceeding 110 km/h, attempting to ram offenders off the road. The game features a betting system where players wager on race outcomes against other championship drivers, and progression requires completing Divisional Challenge time trials. Players can purchase upgrades including tires, radar jammers, engine improvements, and nitro boosts using race earnings, with each race requiring an entry fee and offering monetary rewards based on performance and successful bets.

name: Xcavator 2025
overview: This is Xcavator 2025 (NES Cartridge), a fully functional NES title built from Oberth’s original design of the same name. First developed at Incredible Technologies Inc., the company behind coin-op classics like Golden Tee Golf, Big Buck Hunter, and more, Xcavator was shopped around to multiple publishers across the country way back in 1991, but it never found a home, and was quietly archived and never looked at again.

name: A Magical Tale: Revoke DX
overview: Venture to a new island and find locals in horror, it's your task to return their sacred gems that have been scattered by evils bestowed upon the land. Step into caverns, defeat enemies, and solve puzzles as Hero...

name: Pocket Aquarium
overview: Pocket Aquarium is a virtual pet sim where you collect new fish to feed and play with every day!

name: Crypt Sweeper
overview: Crypt Sweeper is a brand new spooky puzzle game for the Game Boy Advance. It is available in physical format and digital download for emulators and systems capable of playing ROM files.

name: Piropa
overview:
Your virtual frog friend!

Raise your new pet by catching bugs, growing flowers, and taking care of their needs. Pet, feed, and clean up after them, then watch as they grow from tiny tadpole into one of six unique adults. With relaxing gameplay, fun music, and cute sprites, you’re sure to enjoy spending time with your very own virtual frog.

Hop to it!

name: Slaughter
overview: Slaughter is a first person shooter for the Nintendo Entertainment System.

name: Stunner
overview: STUNNER brings arcade action to your Nintendo Game Boy! Jet through ten levels of twisting pipe. Raise spoilers to cling to the inside curve. Draft past hair-trigger bombs and slam against rock-solid repulsors for the boost to go all the way over the top. It's 360 degrees of non-stop high-speed 3D!

name: Orpheus: To Hell and Back
overview: Orpheus: To Hell and Back is a adventure game for the gameboy, where the player plays as Orpheus descending into the Underworld to rescue Eurydice. You have your magical lute that allows you to play songs that pull or push enemies toward you, or put them to sleep momentarily.

name: Lost Treasure of Lima
overview: In 1820 Captain William Thompson was put in charge of transporting Spains riches from Lima to Mexico. Unable to resist the treasures temptation they turned pirate. Heading for Cocos Island off the coast of Costa Rica Thompson and his men allegedly buried the treasure. Thompson and the crew were eventually captured and put on trial for piracy. The treasure has forever lain dormant. Now the hunt begins...

name: Delver Quest
overview:
Whimsical Fantasy: Action Platformer Puzzle

Built for speed-running from the ground up with a built-in game cycle timer.
Unlock items which grant new abilities, opening the possibility for alternate routing!
Collect all of the Crystal Bubble items to discover the bonus quest — a truly “Nintendo hard” experience!
Run, jump, and dive across four exciting worlds with over 150 levels and challenging bosses!

name: Twin Cobra
overview: The NES/Famicom port of Twin Cobra. A helicopter themed shoot 'em up action game from a birds eye view. Developed by Toaplan, it is the successor to their first STG Tiger-Heli, and features similar gameplay.

name: Mai Nurse
overview: Mai Nurse is a tile-matching puzzle video game. The player must help Mai get rid of viruses with pills, lining up 4 slots of the same color horizontally or vertically to destroy them and progress through the levels.

name: Mai Nurse
overview: Mai Nurse is a tile-matching puzzle video game. The player must help Mai get rid of viruses with pills, lining up 4 slots of the same color horizontally or vertically to destroy them and progress through the levels.

name: Mai Nurse
overview: Mai Nurse is a tile-matching puzzle video game. The player must help Mai get rid of viruses with pills, lining up 4 slots of the same color horizontally or vertically to destroy them and progress through the levels.

name: Oni
overview: On a routine cargo run, you notice your ship rapidly losing energy. You locate a nearby planet and begin the landing sequence. On entering the atmosphere a sudden burst of energy surges through your ship systems. You exit your ship on a quest to obtain the energy of the planet and return home.

name: Space Twins
overview: Experience the thrilling universe of Space Twins for the Game Boy Advance, an action-packed adventure released in 2003. With its captivating gameplay and unique mechanics, this unknown title promises to transport players into a captivating space odyssey. Join forces and explore the cosmos in this intriguing and rare ROM that appeals to both collectors and action game enthusiasts alike.

name: The Trial of Kharzoid
overview: The Trial of Kharzoid is an arkanoidvania for the NES. It combines classic brick-breaking games like Arkanoid with Castlevania's classic elements like exploration, defeating huge bosses and eating chicken you find in walls! The goal is to navigate through the deadly levels and go back to Kharzoid's tower to defeat this son of a witch. You will learn more about the lore by talking to NPCs.

name: Gbbbs5
overview: The internet has been shut down and your friend has been blamed for releasing a virus. Can you find proof to clear his name? A nostalgic cozy game inspired by memories of growing up in the 1990s.

name: Sword of the Apocalypse
overview: After narrowly avoiding total extinction, the human race is finally beginning to thrive again; building cities and slowly reconnecting across the globe... But an evil doomsday cult is planning to end the human race once and for all.

name: Walfie's Nonograms
overview: Walfie's Nonograms is a nonogram puzzle game for the Game Boy Color, featuring 150 puzzles

name: Roguecraft GB
overview:
Roguecraft GB is an award-winning, retro-inspired, turn-based roguelike that’s all about simplicity and fun. Explore procedurally generated dungeons laden with mysterious potions, scary chickens, and secret rooms just waiting to be discovered.

Can you conquer the maze-like depths of the dungeons and defeat the terrifying tentacle-toting boss on the final level? You only have one life, so be careful, but if you reach the end there are wonderful rewards to be gathered!

Good luck, brave warrior!

name: Cave Dave
overview:
Cave Dave is an action platformer in its purest form: armed with a limited supply of ropes and bombs - and your wits and cunning - the aim is to plunder the three caves in each system to find Dave's beloved PSP while avoiding the many enemy inhabitants which lurk in the darkness.

There's even a secret system, should you have the chops to unlock it...

name: Obelisk
overview:
You wake up in a cold hallway. You don't know how you got there, but as your vision clears, you notice two fellow adventurers. They are as confused to how they got there.

The only way out is up. You are inside one of the feared Obelisks that have been spawning across the land. Legend has it no one has ever made it out alive, the shifting maze merely growing upward as new floors are open.

name: Urcicus
overview: Veve, a mischievous jester deer (or Jesdeer) accidentally shatters a great crystalline star, releasing an evil spirit hellbent on causing chaos and destruction to the world. She goes on a quest to collect the fragments and undo what havoc she unleashed.

name: Save Me Cows
overview:
Save Me Cows! is an action puzzle game in the ChuChu Rocket! genre.

Save Me Cows! features 100 mind bending levels, detailed pixel art, 100% custom assembly code, multiple endings, hours of fun, with original chiptune music. It's Game Boy Color compatible, and has monochrome palettes for DMG, Lite, and Pocket. And best of all, it's suitable for all ages!

name: Masturbrowse
overview:
Curiosity didn't kill the cat, but it will kill 150 million sperm cells.

Created in a few forgetful weeks as a companion piece to Ferarum but it's alright as a standalone too.

name: Kenny vs. Spenny: The Handheld Game
overview: Since the beginning of time mankind has been forced to compete for survival. This spirit of competition has reached a pinnacle in the relationship of two best friends who battle against each other. Why? ... Glory for the winner, humiliation for the loser. This is KENNY v.s. SPENNY, The Handheld Game.

name: Dozy in Grackleland
overview:
The main goal of Grackle is to control a little lazy caterpillar named Dozy, who is a bit of a late bloomer. Hatching later than the rest of his buds, he's got to hustle across a few trees, eating leaves and avoiding danger.
The main threats of Grackle include starvation, thorns, frogs, spiders, and of course, grackles.

name: Friday the 13th Revisited
overview:
Friday the 13th: Camp Crystal Lake is a tribute to the 1988 NES classic, recreated from scratch for the Game Boy Color with new gameplay mechanics and a portable experience.

Step into the shoes of one of the counselors and explore the campground as you try to survive the threat of Jason Voorhees. Your goal: protect your friends, find items that will help you take on Jason—who is lurking around Crystal Lake Camp—before he finds you.

Will you be able to survive until dawn?

name: Cyber Dreamscape Battle-Deckers 2199
overview: It's some time in the early 2000s, and Cyber Dreamscape Battle-Deckers 2199 is a digital-only card game that's developed a vibrant and loyal community thanks to its freedom of character expression and the giant game cabinets it's played on. Even in your small US college town, there are players who meet and trade matches at the nearby city mall. For better or worse, the game shop in the mall is the only location close by with an officially-sanctioned CDBD battle arena setup. This has let all kinds of hyper-local tournaments and events pop up at the game shop, with all kinds of players showing up to participate. Unfortunately, it's not all fun and games when not everyone in the community gets along or plays fair- even in a game where you can spectate a brawl between a slime-girl made of bubblegum and a wrestler in a teddy bear mask..!

name: Four of a Kind: A Short Horror Anthology
overview: "A horror fiction kinetic novel made especially for the Game Boy (and Super Game Boy)! Go through a linear, zero-choice visual novel made up of 4 short horror vignettes, each inspired by very personal fears and anxieties, and using real photos that [the dev] adapted for the Game Boy- many taken with [their] actual Game Boy Camera! Just a small series of nightmares, all over in about 15 minutes or so. [They] promise~"

name: Cosmo Command
overview: COSMO COMMAND is a love letter to classic Game Boy shmups and a certain franchise featuring animals flying space ships. Try for the highest score while listening to banter from your teammates and take part in a story of galactic proportions!

name: Junk Runner 64
overview: Junk Runner 64 is an open world game in which you control Jax, a young boy who is tasked with saving his sick brother. Traverse a giant desert in order to find junk that will help you repair various machines, do timed races to receive rewards that will let you upgrade your hover bike and take in the incredible sights of ancient ruins and near endless dunes.

name: Kurohi
overview:
Explore interconnected areas, uncover hidden secrets, and unlock powerful abilities as you fight your way through deranged bosses and discover a mysterious world filled with danger, lore, and unexpected twists.

Kurohi combines tight platforming, overhead exploration, and arcade-style space shooter gameplay, creating a dynamic adventure that shifts between multiple styles of play. This represents an era of passion for retro gaming, pixel art, and authentic handheld development.

name: Jett Rider Mini H.E.R.O.
overview: Jett Rider Mini H.E.R.O. is a classic Game Boy-style adventure set in the Jett Rider universe. A small mission. A big heart. A true handheld hero.

name: Overserved: Food Fighters!
overview: Overserved: Food Fighters is a fast-paced multiplayer party brawler for 1–8 players. Pick an adorable critter, dash through chaotic arenas, and hurl food-themed projectiles at your rivals in frantic matches with full cross-play across every platform.

name: Echoes of the Unread
overview: Jump and sing to unlock the secrets of the library. Singing will change the world around you and your abilities improve as you explore.

name: Dracula: Dark Reign
overview:
Dracula: Dark Reign is a Castlevania-style video game that will take players on an immersive journey into the dark and captivating world of Bram Stoker's iconic vampire tale. Dracula: Dark Reign promises to offer a unique blend of storytelling, exploration, and action to relive Jonathan Harker's daring escape from Castle Dracula!

Set against the backdrop of the tumultuous First World War era, the game delves deep into the lore of Bram Stoker's original novel, seamlessly pushing the storyline forward while maintaining the essence of the source material.

Dracula: Dark Reign is an Official StokerVerse Game and is developed under license from The StokerVerse Project. Dracula: Dark Reign is the first-ever Stoker family-authorized Dracula video game.

name: Retro Otrop
overview: A struggling writer receives an unexpected call, and his destiny leads him to the small town of Otrop. Now, he must face mysteries that defy life and death in an adventure filled with supernatural fun.

name: Retro Otrop
overview: A struggling writer receives an unexpected call, and his destiny leads him to the small town of Otrop. Now, he must face mysteries that defy life and death in an adventure filled with supernatural fun.

name: Ghost in the Shell GBC
overview:
Released in late 2025 to commemorate the 30th anniversary of the franchise, Ghost in the Shell is a homebrew project for the Game Boy Color, made by avalentine1996, that serves as an aesthetic homage to the 1995 film and the technical era of the late 90s.

Structured primarily as an 8-bit visual novel, the game translates the narrative of the series into a portable format, utilizing detailed pixel-art cutscenes and extensive dialogue. While the core experience focuses on exploration and investigation, the gameplay is diversified through the inclusion of arcade shooting and driving sequences, providing a kinetic counterpoint to the narrative segments.

The narrative center of the experience focuses on the classic cyberpunk tenets of identity and systemic corruption within the Section 9 universe. It emphasizes player agency through a branching structure that offers five distinct endings, encouraging multiple playthroughs to uncover the full scope of the story.

name: Unknown Space
overview: The Darkness Guild is lost in Unknown Space! Go on a top down, bite-sized adventure and blast off to three far out planets. Explore Unknown Space from your ship and collect resources to change the ship's look for the climactic Shoot 'Em Up battle! Do you have what it takes escape from Unknown Space?

name: Ari's Delivery Palooza
overview:
In a calm, small city, there's a young human called Ari who moved there recently, and works with delivery. Which is a fairly easy job -- you receive your order, meet with your client, and then you deliver the package. Or so it should be--

Embark with Ari in this hectic day for delivery services, in a game full of (bad) puns, cute art and an overall feeling of wholesomeness in a game of around 1 hour of gameplay!

name: Unknown Space
overview:
Unknown Space is an action RPG with a climactic shoot 'em up space battle.

This game was made as an entry to GBJam11.

name: The Pazaak Battles
overview: The Pazaak Battles is a recreation of a popular Star Wars card game, with a twist: an alternative adventure featuring Han Solo, and many other characters from Star Wars. This definitely has the potential to become a fan favorite homebrew game.

name: Akumanor Gaiden DX
overview: Orochi terrorises the land! You are Sakura, youkai hunter, and you vow to protect your village and destroy Orochi, who inhabits the most vile of castles, The Akumanor!

name: Double Duck
overview: Double Duck is a puzzle-platformer for Game Boy Color featuring a unique dual-character mechanic.

name: Toy Story Racer
overview: The Game Boy Color port of Toy Story Racer.

name: Sack of Flour, Heart of Gold
overview: Sack of Flour, Heart of Gold is a game developed by Bob Rost. This is a game where the player controls a sack of flour moving through 2d levels in order to avoid certain annihilation by the enemies around them.

name: MarioBreak!
overview: MarioBreak! is a Super Mario themed breakout clone, features multiple levels and a lot of new gameplay.

name: RTA Adventure
overview: This is an unofficial action game starring RTA-chan from “RTA in Japan.”

name: Precrna Rupa
overview:
Precrna Rupa ("Too Black of a Hole" in English) is a short narrative adventure game with a metroidbrainia twist, set in the streets of Zagreb, Croatia. Inspired by POYY, the punk album by Croatian artist IDEM, the game adapts the record's themes, stories, and music into an interactive experience. Players explore the city, talk to its inhabitants, gather information, and connect seemingly unrelated details to progress through the story.

Developed for the Nintendo Game Boy, Precrna Rupa can be played on original hardware, compatible devices, emulators, and directly in a web browser through its Itch.io page. Available in both Croatian and English, it is the first Game Boy game ever released in the Croatian language.

name: Filthy Kitchen
overview: Filthy Kitchen is an 8-bit homebrew action-platformer originally developed for the 2016 Nesdev competition. The game is themed around the chore of cleaning a disastrously messy kitchen, with the primary objective being to navigate the environment to locate a missing broom. As players move through the game, they utilize a swatter to crush flies, featuring a combo system that awards massive score multipliers for taking out multiple flies in a single swing. The gameplay also requires players to dodge thematic environmental hazards, such as dirty dishes and out-of-control appliances, while collecting fresh food to restore health and increase their score. The game is available to play directly in a web browser or as a downloadable ROM for NES emulators.

name: Scorching Light
overview:
Scorching Light is a horror-action-platformer game with puzzle elements.
Any light enemy, item or liquid will kill the protagonist.
The core mechanic of my game is that you can hide from the light enemies by blending into the environment.

name: Bumpers & Broadswords Mini
overview:
Collect, Battle, and face the final Elites!

Your home city has been taken over for the biggest and best tournament! BUMPERS & BROADSWORDS MINI has 40 unique and balanced Bumpers - the trick lies in choosing which 4 you want, and which will synergise in the most powerful ways!

name: Kiana & Biscuit: Pirates on a Visit!
overview: A retro platforming game where two ladies, Kiana and Biscuit go on a vacation to a private island to spend time with their partners, only to be interrupted by dastardly pirates! Jump, collect coconuts and tokens, beat the par times, and aim for high ranks to unlock images in the gallery!

name: Kiana & Biscuit: Pirates on a Visit!
overview: A retro platforming game where two ladies, Kiana and Biscuit go on a vacation to a private island to spend time with their partners, only to be interrupted by dastardly pirates! Jump, collect coconuts and tokens, beat the par times, and aim for high ranks to unlock images in the gallery!

name: Annalog
overview: Annalog is a "Zachtroidvania" homebrew NES game, combining Zach-like programming puzzles with Metroidvania-style platforming, exploration, upgrades, and bosses.

name: Dream Grove Gardens: First Shift
overview: A top down RPG for Gameboy about a grub's first day as an employee at the greatest theme park in the world, Dream Grove Gardens!

name: Heavy Barrel
overview: Heavy Barrel is a top-down run-and-gun shooter developed by Data East for the Nintendo Entertainment System. Terrorists have seized an underground control complex at a nuclear missile site, and the player must fight through the enemy installation and eliminate its leader. Weapons, grenades, and other power-ups can be found throughout the facility, while keys are used to open locked containers. The ultimate goal is to locate the six pieces of the powerful Heavy Barrel weapon, reassemble it, and use it to defeat the enemy forces. The NES version supports one- or two-player cooperative play.

name: Hey You, Pikachu! Demake
overview: The Hey You! Pikachu Demake is a charming 2D Game Boy-style demake of the classic Nintendo 64 virtual pet game.

name: Abyss
overview: You wake up at home with a splitting headache, only to discover that something isn’t quite right. A strange broadcast urges you to stay inside and avoid contact with the outside world. As tension builds, your surroundings begin to shift in unsettling ways, and your attempts to reach loved ones are met with unexpected obstacles.

name: TV-Chan's Great Escape!: GB
overview: Help TV-Chan sneak out in this GBC game!

name: Blupi's Adventures
overview: (Re)discover two classic Blupi adventures (also known as Eggbert in English), brought to Game Boy Color for the very first time!

name: Pixel Pup
overview: Pixel Pup is a nonogram game, in the style of Picross, for the Game Boy Advance. Enjoy puzzles from various themed packs, including DIY, The Nineties, Zoology, and a Taiyaki Fabulous crossover!

name: Tavern Farkle GB
overview: Tavern Farkle GB is a push-your-luck dice game for the Game Boy. Roll six dice, bank your points or risk it all. Play a quick match against a random villager, or take on six opponents in a row, ending with Lucifer himself and his wild Devil's Die.

name: Moxie // Graffiti Burst
overview: A fast-paced, flow-based 2D skate-n-tag game set in the gritty urban city known as the Mischievous South.
